title: Project data
description: The `data` of a project entry: a built or proposed landscape and its plant list. `client` and `constructionBudget` are proprietary: blank in this repo (config/types.json fixtureRules). State, county, and town are derived from `location` (P6).

location.description: WGS 84, decimal degrees, at most 5 decimal places; must fall inside WA, OR, or CA (lib/validate.ts).

constructionBudget.description: Landscape construction, US dollars, not adjusted for inflation.

completed.description: Required when constructed; an expected date when proposed.
